verdict.rationale: Weave automatically records token usage and calculates cost for each call, applies built-in per-model pricing, and shows costs in the trace tree and calls table. That covers per-request visibility and model-level pricing. There is no evidence of dashboards that aggregate cost and tokens by model or over time periods. Missing for 10: aggregated cost/token dashboards by model, time-period breakdowns or charts, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Weave automatically records token usage and calculates cost for each call. Costs appear in the trace tree and in the calls table in the Weave UI.
Weave captures token usage from the API response and applies built-in pricing for the model, with no extra code required.
The three required fields are `llm_id`, `prompt_token_cost`, and `completion_token_cost`.
